name: Wardens of the Hearth
description: Village militia and roll-keepers who record the names of every settlement so none can go quiet.

name: The Sayers' Circle
description: Mages who hold that Saying, speaking the world louder, is the only honest craft. They keep three contradictory accounts of the Dwindling and teach all of them.

name: The Quiet Hands
description: Tollmere's thieves, who practise Hush and keep the Unsaid Ledger of every price the law has ever taken.

name: The Tolling Order
description: Knights who keep vigil over the Choir. Grim, kind, and doomed, and they do not make a fuss about it.

name: The Tallymen
description: The merchants' guild of Tollmere. Property, trade, prices, and the paid watch that passes for law in the city.

name: The Clan-Moot
description: Seven clans, one Moot. Blood-price instead of jail; memory instead of ledgers.

name: The Reed Council
description: The elders of Isseva. Their only punishment is exile from the boardwalks, which in the marsh is a slow sentence.

name: The Woodfolk
description: Foresters and hunters of the Briarwold. They have no law, only custom, and bows.
